changelog:
Initial release of nexus-ciba-wechat skill.

- Generates shareable HTML and PNG cards from the 词霸每日一句 (Ciba Daily Sentence) API.
- Supports multiple magazine-style templates: vertical friends-circle and horizontal postcard layouts.
- Embeds QR codes for pronunciation audio (tts field from API).
- Automatically fetches daily sentences, prefers available API images, and falls back to generated images on failure.
- Uses Playwright to render HTML templates to downloadable PNGs.
- Simple template system enables customization; full documentation included on usage and output structure.
summary: generate shareable html and png cards from the ciba or iciba daily sentence api. use when the user asks for 词霸每日一句, iciba, ciba, open.iciba.com/dsapi, daily...
